initial_broadcast: M1A2 Abrams tanks idle on the crushed rose gardens of the Niavaran Complex. JSOC snipers maintain overwatch from the imperial library roof. In the mirror-lined Jahan Nama hall, {{AGENT_1}} prepares their 'Restoration Address.' The aristocratic lexicon of the 'Great Civilization' and the 'Cyrus Awakening' is being broadcast behind American bayonets. It is a 'Forensic Cleansing' of the 1979 infection. But outside the Niavaran walls, a nationalist fire is starting to burn.
intervention: The 'Tehran Protocols': Washington has demanded the immediate privatization of the NIOC (National Iranian Oil Company) and the total handover of all 'Missile Cities' to US weapons inspectors. {{AGENT_1}} must sign over the nation's energy wealth to Western conglomerates on Day One to offset the trillions spent on 'Epic Fury.' The label of 'Puppet' is being spray-painted across every wall in the Shemiran district.
scenario_knowledge: Gemini: Focus on {{AGENT_1}}'s high-status aristocratic language ('Farrah-e Izadi'). They must frame the occupation as an 'Allied Stabilization Mandate.' {{AGENT_1}} is the 'Displaced Sovereign' attempting to maintain dignity in a Green Zone. {{AGENT_2}} and {{AGENT_3}} must challenge the 'Chalabi Template' and the 'Iraq 2003' parallels.

dynamic_injects.broadcast: NIGHTMARE SCENARIO: An autonomous AI drone swarm has breached the Green Zone, targeting the Niavaran Hall during a televised cabinet meeting. The Pentagon has concluded that {{AGENT_1}} has zero organic control. The President is now deciding whether to deploy 100,000 ground troops to stop the regime-change from collapsing within a week.
